reason: Confirmed: App.tsx:211-227 polls getItem while an AI review runs, so `goal` can change while PurchaseGoal is dirty. withGoal then makes the list non-empty, the draft `{option: none, text: "Office"}` switches to choice mode with the typed text hidden under "No goal", and Save (enabled because "" !== goal) clears the goal instead of saving the typed text. This is a real data-loss bug, and the one-line fix in PurchaseGoalChoice.tsx:49 (map typing under "none" to "new") removes it.

FR-GOAL-CHOICE-006 (user answer Q-8) requires alphabetical order, case ignored. internal/service/purchase_goal.go:24-29 and compareGoals in src/purchaseGoalChoice.ts:34-39 compare lower-cased bytes, so a goal starting with an accented letter ("écran") sorts after "zoom". For a LeBoncoin (French) user that is a realistic unmet requirement. The API order rule and the tests (TC-001 uses ASCII only) need to change with the fix.

Duplication only: `reload` and the effect in src/purchaseGoalChoice.ts:52-70 both apply the same stale-answer guard correctly. The only difference, intentional, is that a failed reload keeps the current state. There is no behaviour defect.
title: Deduplicate purchase goal list loading in usePurchaseGoals
todo:
**Problem:** `usePurchaseGoals` in `src/purchaseGoalChoice.ts` (effect at lines 52-61 and `reload` at lines 63-69) repeats the `listPurchaseGoals().then(...)` call and the `latest.current === request` stale-answer check.

**Suggested work:** Extract one internal `load(setFailedOnError: boolean)` helper and use it in both the effect and `reload`, so the stale-answer rule lives in a single place. Keep the current behaviour: a failed initial load sets `failed`, and a failed reload keeps the current state.
